title: Scientists discover a natural compound that could protect the brain from too much salt
caption:
Excessive salt does more than strain your cardiovascular system—in animal models, it degrades cognitive and social function. Japanese researchers found that a soy lipid called LPC70 balanced out inflammatory signaling in the kidneys and restored protective receptors in the brain.

Source: Sciencedaily - Scientists discover a natural compound that could protect the brain from too much salt

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/10/261017230032.htm
